api.title: API clients
api.description: Keys that let connected systems, such as clock-machine gateways, call this system without a person signing in. Each key has its own permissions, allowed addresses and limit.
api.denied: You may not see API clients.
api.loadError: The API clients could not be loaded.
api.empty.body: Create an API client to give a connected system a key.
api.col.name: Name
api.field.name: Name
api.field.name.help: What this key is for, for example the gateway of the Lahore office.
api.field.scopes.help: The key can do only what you tick here, and nothing else.
api.field.ip.help: One address or range a line, for example 203.0.113.7 or 10.1.2.0/24. With none, the key is refused every time.
api.field.rate.help: More than this in a minute are refused until the next minute.
api.field.expires.help: Leave empty for a key that does not expire.
api.create.waiting: The key was made, but it opens nothing until a second person approves it.
api.rotate.title: Make a new secret
api.rotate.effect: A new secret is made for {name}. The old one keeps working for a while so the connected system can switch.
api.revoke.title: Revoke this key
api.revoke.effect: {name} stops working at once. This cannot be undone; make a new API client to connect it again.
api.usage.title: Use of {name}
api.secret.title: Copy the key now
api.secret.body: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it where the connected system keeps its secrets; it cannot be read again, only replaced.
api.secret.waiting: It does not work yet: another person must approve it first.
api.secret.label: API key
api.secret.copyFailed: The key could not be copied; select it and copy it by hand.
api.error.ip: One of the addresses is not valid.
api.error.rate: Enter a whole number above zero.
